birth_time.title: What time were you born?
birth_time.subtitle: This determines your Ascendant and house placements
birth_time.clock_hint: Enter the time as shown on the clock at your birthplace.
birth_time.timezone_hint: We'll use the {{timezone}} timezone for calculations.
birth_time.estimate_hint: Don't know your exact birth time? Enter your best estimate.
birth_time.confidence_label: How sure are you of this time?
birth_time.confidence_margin: We'll treat this as accurate within ±{{minutes}} min.
birth_time.confidence_exact_note: We'll treat this as an exact time.
birth_time.confidence_unknown_note: We'll use noon as a placeholder — you can refine it by hand later in Settings.
birth_time.dst_gap: {{time}} did not exist in {{zone}} on this date: the clocks jumped forward an hour for daylight saving. Please check the time on the birth record.
birth_time.dst_overlap: {{time}} happened twice in {{zone}} on this date (the clocks went back an hour). Which one was it?

life_events.title: Share Your Life Story
life_events.subtitle: Optional. If you like, jot down a few life events in your own words — they're saved on this device as private notes you can use later to refine an uncertain birth time by hand. Skip anytime; your chart is ready without them.
life_events.why_body: Big moments — a marriage, a career change, a child — line up with planetary periods, so later they make handy reference points if you refine an uncertain birth time by hand in Settings: nudge the time, watch the Ascendant shift, and see which fits. Entirely optional — the app never matches events to timing or changes your birth time for you.
life_events.textarea_label: Tell us about your life events:
life_events.textarea_placeholder: For example: I got married in 2015, had my first child in 2018, changed careers in 2020...
life_events.privacy_note: Organization stays on-device unless you connected AI. If AI is connected, pressing Save sends only this narrative to your connected AI provider to create typed event rows; your birth details and chart stay on this device.
life_events.min_length_error: Please describe at least one significant life event.
life_events.saved_feedback: Thanks! Your story is saved on this device as notes to help you rectify your birth time by hand in Settings.
examples: I got married in June 2015, had my first child in 2018, and changed careers from engineering to teaching in 2020.
My father passed away when I was 23, I bought my first house at 30, and I relocated from New York to California in 2019.
I've had a stable life - same job for 15 years, married my college sweetheart in 2010, two kids born in 2012 and 2015.

generating.title: Generating Your Chart
generating.subtitle: This may take a minute...
generating.keep_open: Computing your chart on this device. Keep this page open until it is saved.

error.title: Connection Issue
error.default_body: Unable to check chart generation status. Your chart may already be ready.
error.reset_hint: Still stuck? Clear the cached engine data and reload for a clean start.
error.still_warming: The on-device engine is still preparing — hang tight, your chart will generate as soon as it's ready.
error.help: If your chart was already generated, you'll see it on the dashboard. Otherwise, try generating again.
